about_the_game:
Background Story: 

Grepa was not a fan of parties, but she went to anyway because her coworker couldn't stop bothering her to go in one.  Upon arrival, she was lucky to come across a friend of hers who happens to be the host of the Halloween party to bear with the burdened chattering  around  her.  All things were fine and well, until she counters  a certain group of "old" friends that doesn't exactly remind her of pleasant memories.

That is when she snaps at her host friend,  creating a ruckus over the party. It didn't take long for Grepa to start dashing out the front door and throwing a middle finger at them.  She never wanted to go home so bad after that, but then remembered her car was busted. With that, Grepa had no choice but to walk herself back home.

She knew it wasn't going to be easy, but she didn't expect the way back to become so...

...spooky.

HUMEROUS [REBOOT] is a reboot of my old game Humerous! It is a story-rich RPG adventure horror game about a gal who wants to go home after an unpleasant counter at the party. Sadly her car's busted, so she has no choice but to walk home! But little did she know that taking a break from walking in the middle of a forest has it's own...consequences.  How Grepa gets to home is all up to YOU to decide! 

Maybe also perhaps help uncover a...cold case? She was looking at something else during that break after all...

Have fun with the story! And H A P P Y H A L L O W E E N!

The game includes:  

  • 5 bad endings,  3 normal endings, and 1 true ending! 

  • Fully-drawn CGS! (20+)

Thank you to my close friends, good pals, and inspirations that helped me feel motivated to make this reboot!
